method: Ordinary 2023 photo, existing map identity and the standard PMTiles/Mapzen pipeline. Existing documented nominal dimensions retained without bespoke re-research.

pictures.author: Axel Pettersson
pictures.usage: Viewed in browser. No copied pixels, no texture import.

observations: Paired shallow bowstring trusses over a narrow pedestrian deck
Open X-braced steel trestles above rounded masonry piers
Downstream large utility main and pole line

features.note: The extract keeps zooms 0-maxLevel, so the archive also carries layers the app never reads: landcover (zoom 0-7), earth, boundaries and places.

dataLicenses.appliesTo: roads, buildings, water, landuse, earth, boundaries, places, pois

dataLicenses.source: Daylight Landcover, derived from ESA WorldCover
dataLicenses.attribution: © ESA WorldCover project; contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data processed by the ESA WorldCover consortium

dataLicenses.appliesTo: low-zoom context attributes in boundaries/places and the places minzoom configuration

elevation.subseaPolicy: Negative Terrarium values are flattened to the sea/lake surface datum (0 m); this fixture does not encode bathymetry.
elevation.attribution: Mapzen; terrain data courtesy of the U.S. Geological Survey

limitations: Geometry represents the observed 2023 exterior, not proof of current works or seasonal water stage.
Individual dimensions, equal span division and concealed details remain reconstructed.
